lines.text: Cut me some slack, I'm new.

data.define: To ask someone to be less strict or critical.

example.text: Cut me some slack, I'm new.

misuse.text: Don't tell your boss 'cut me some slack' daily.

data.l1_hook: ‘cut me some slack’, 난 처음이야. 부디 좀 봐줘!
data.l1_ex: 나 신입이야, 'cut me some slack'(봐주면서 해줘).
